scope: Preserve operation text; no RNG, selector, scores, provider, UI or persistence change

replacements.old:
# The prompt serialises the idea dict as JSON, so the operations must be
    # present in the dict the producer hands us. Older ideas (tests, golden
    # fixtures) may not carry them; in that case we leave the prompt as-is
    # rather than crash the whole generation flow.
    if not ("method1_desc" in idea and "method2_desc" in idea):
        pass
    else:
        prompt_text = json.dumps(datos, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True)
        assert idea["method1_desc"] in prompt_text or idea["method1_desc"][:40] in prompt_text, \
            "method1 operation lost between idea and prompt"
        assert idea["method2_desc"] in prompt_text or idea["method2_desc"][:40] in prompt_text, \
            "method2 operation lost between idea and prompt"
